shows.title: Jacob Mosley: One Night
shows.description: In the world premiere of "Jacob Mosley: One Night," three-time Emmy winner Justin Shenkarow channels the charm of Frank Sinatra and the showmanship of Bobby Darin in an electrifying one-man musical packed with original songs, immersive storytelling, and unexpected twists. Best known as the voice of Harold Berman on Nickelodeon's iconic "Hey Arnold!," actor, producer, director and writer Shenkarow transports audiences into the world of a charismatic 1950s nightclub entertainer whose extraordinary life may not be quite what it seems. Created by Shenkarow and Kristina Kelly, the limited run plays December 17-19 at NYC's Reverie Room.
